note: No official public per-member ethics category register. Article 286 of the 1992 Constitution and the Public Office Holders (Declaration of Assets and Disqualification) Act, 1998 (Act 550) require sitting Members of Parliament to file asset declarations with the Auditor-General; those filings are sealed and are not a public category list. CHRAJ and Ghana Audit Service pages have no sitting-MP public interests register. Public categories only if an official public page exists. No amounts. No private donor names. Honest empty.
